title: Builder BLD-002: Radius, breakpoints and editor tokens

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-002.

detail: B0 Align, pass BLD-002 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-002). Radius, breakpoints and editor tokens. Scope: design system tokens. Gates: check:tokens, Design system adherence check, pr-compare visual suite, Pass probes, check:contrast, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: nothing. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.
